57161-notes-of-a-gold-digger-and-gold-di.title: Gold Diggers’ Guide,
57161-notes-of-a-gold-digger-and-gold-di.creator: Unknown
57161-notes-of-a-gold-digger-and-gold-di.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “They come—they come.” Well, let them come; and I for one will be glad to see them as lucky as their hearts can wish. In order to give the embryo digger a little insight into the wonders of this wonderful region, I have noted down a few facts, the result of my own experience as a Gold Digger.

arxiv-2110-01977.title: Analytic scattering parameters at low energies.
arxiv-2110-01977.creator: E. Z. Liverts
arxiv-2110-01977.description: Abstract The scattering of two and more particles at low energies is described by the so called effective-range expansion. The leading terms of this expansion are the scattering length and effective range. The analytic expressions for both of the aforementioned scattering parameters are presented for the inverse-power potential and the Woods-Saxon potential.

arxiv-2205-10475.title: DeepStruct : Pretraining of Language Models for Structure Prediction
arxiv-2205-10475.creator: Chenguang Wang, Xiao Liu, Zui Chen, Haoyun Hong, Jie Tang, Dawn Song
arxiv-2205-10475.description: Abstract We introduce a method for improving the structural understanding abilities of language models. Unlike previous approaches that finetune the models with task-specific augmentation, we pretrain language models on a collection of task-agnostic corpora to generate structures from text. Our structure pretraining enables zero-shot transfer of the learned knowledge that models have about the structure tasks.

arxiv-2205-11623.title: Flip Distance and Triangulations of a Ball
arxiv-2205-11623.creator: Zili Wang
arxiv-2205-11623.description: Abstract It is known that the flip distance between two triangulations of a convex polygon is related to the minimum number of tetrahedra in the triangulation of some polyhedron. It is interesting to know whether these two numbers are the same.

arxiv-2208-02895.title: Automatic Segmentation of the Placenta in BOLD MRI Time Series
arxiv-2208-02895.creator: S. Mazdak Abulnaga, Sean I. Young, Katherine Hobgood, Eileen Pan, Clinton J. Wang, P. Ellen Grant, Esra Abaci Turk, Polina Golland
arxiv-2208-02895.description: Abstract Blood oxygen level dependent (BOLD) MRI with maternal hyperoxia can assess oxygen transport within the placenta and has emerged as a promising tool to study placental function. Measuring signal changes over time requires segmenting the placenta in each volume of the time series.

arxiv-2303-07146.title: NeuroQL: A Neuro-Symbolic Language and Dataset for Inter-Subjective Reasoning
arxiv-2303-07146.creator: Nick Papoulias
arxiv-2303-07146.description: Abstract We present a new AI task and baseline solution for Inter-Subjective Reasoning. We define inter-subjective information, to be a mixture of objective and subjective information possibly shared by different parties. Examples may include commodities and their objective properties as reported by IR (Information Retrieval) systems, that need to be cross-referenced with subjective user reviews from an online forum.

arxiv-2305-09191.title: Ionized gas metallicity of the strong [O iii ] λ \lambda 5007 emission-line compact galaxies in the LAMOST survey Facilities: LAMOST, SDSS, WISE, GALEX astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , extinction ( Barbary 2016 ) , LMFIT ( Newville et al. 2016 ) , M

arxiv-2305-09191.description: Abstract This article reports a sample of 1830 strong [O iii ] λ \lambda 5007 emission-line compact galaxies discovered with the LAMOST spectroscopic survey and the photometric catalog of SDSS. We newly identify 402 spectra of 346 strong [O iii ] λ \lambda 5007 emission-line compact galaxies by finding compact isolated point sources.

Caselli, S. Charnley, D. Johnstone, Z.E. Zhang, M.J. Maureira, Y. Zhang, G. Sabatini, B. Svoboda, I. Jiménez-Serra, L. Loinard,
arxiv-2402-10258.description: Abstract The ALMA interferometer has played a key role in revealing a new component of the Sun-like star forming process: the molecular streamers, i.e. structures up to thousands of au long funneling material non-axisymmetrically to disks. In the context of the FAUST ALMA LP, the archetypical VLA1623-2417 protostellar cluster has been imaged at 1.

arxiv-2405-12163.title: Fennec: Fine-grained Language Model Evaluation and Correction Extended through Branching and Bridging
arxiv-2405-12163.creator: Xiaobo Liang ∗, Haoke Zhang, Helan hu, Juntao Li, Jun Xu, Min Zhang
arxiv-2405-12163.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of large language models has given rise to a plethora of applications across a myriad of real-world tasks, mainly centered on aligning with human intent. However, the complexities inherent in human intent necessitate a dependence on labor-intensive and time-consuming human evaluation.

arxiv-2406-12142.title: Slicing Through Bias: Explaining Performance Gaps in Medical Image Analysis using Slice Discovery Methods
arxiv-2406-12142.creator: Vincent Olesen, Nina Weng, Aasa Feragen, Eike Petersen
arxiv-2406-12142.description: Abstract Machine learning models have achieved high overall accuracy in medical image analysis. However, performance disparities on specific patient groups pose challenges to their clinical utility, safety, and fairness. This can affect known patient groups – such as those based on sex, age, or disease subtype – as well as previously unknown and unlabeled groups.

arxiv-2507-08901.title: End-to-End Generation of City-Scale Vectorized Maps by Crowdsourced Vehicles Thanks: *Corresponding author: Miao Fan (miao.fan@ieee.org), professor at Beijing Institute of Graphic Communication, senior member of IEEE.
arxiv-2507-08901.creator: Zebang Feng, Miao Fan, Bao Liu, Shengtong Xu, Haoyi Xiong
arxiv-2507-08901.description: Abstract High-precision vectorized maps are indispensable for autonomous driving, yet traditional LiDAR-based creation is costly and slow, while single-vehicle perception methods lack accuracy and robustness, particularly in adverse conditions. This paper introduces EGC-VMAP, an end-to-end framework that overcomes these limitations by generating accurate, city-scale vectorized maps through the aggregation of data from crowdsourced vehicles.

arxiv-2601-04258.creator: Arjun Maniyar

pmc-10539874.creator: Raphaelle Aubrais, Krimo Bouabdallah, Loic Chartier, Charles Herbaux, Anne Banos, Pauline Brice, David Sibon, Jean Marc Schiano, Thomas Cluzeau, Kamel Laribi, Ronan Le Calloch, Mathieu Bellal, Baptiste Delapierre, Nicolas Daguindau, Sandy Amorim, Kossi Agbetiafa, Adrien Chauchet, Caroline Besson, Er

pmc-10589068.title: The Differences of Quantitative Flow Ratio in Coronary Artery Stenosis with or without Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-10589068.creator: Wenbin Lu, Xiaoguo Zhang, Gaoliang Yan, Genshan Ma
pmc-10589068.description: Quantitative flow ratio (QFR) is a new method for the assessment of the extent of coronary artery stenosis. But it may be obscured by the cardiac remodeling and abnormal blood flow of the coronary artery when encountering atrial fibrillation (AF).

pmc-10836366.title: ﻿Description of the first stygobiotic species of the atyid shrimp genus Sinodina (Decapoda, Caridea, Atyidae) from Yunnan Province, China
pmc-10836366.creator: Xuankong Jiang, Jiajun Zhou, Jianguo Wang, Wenlong Chen, Huiming Chen
pmc-10836366.description: ﻿Abstract​Sinodina Liang & Cai, 1999, a genus of atyid shrimp, is endemic to China and distributed only in the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau. We describe here the thirteen species of Sinodina, and the first cave-dweller of the genus, Sinodinaashimasp. nov., collected from a limestone cave in Shilin County, Yunnan Province.

pmc-11331873.title: The newly proposed plasma-glycosylated hemoglobin A1c/High-Density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio serves as a simple and practical indicator for screening metabolic associated fatty liver disease: an observational study based on a physical examination population
pmc-11331873.creator: Shiming He, Song Lu, Changhui Yu, Maobin Kuang, Jiajun Qiu, Guotai Sheng, Yang Zou
pmc-11331873.description: BackgroundGlycotoxicity and lipotoxicity are key pathophysiological mechanisms underlying the development of metabolic associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD). The primary objective of this study is to investigate the association between the newly proposed Plasma-Glycosylated Hemoglobin A1c/High-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Ratio (HbA1c/HDL-C ratio) and the risk of MAFLD.MethodsA study population of 14,251 individuals undergoing health examinations was included.

pmc-11496880.title: First fossil mountain midges (Diptera, Deuterophlebiidae) and their evolutionary and ecological implication
pmc-11496880.creator: Ewa Krzemińska, Agnieszka Soszyńska, Iwona Kania-Kłosok, Kornelia Skibińska, Katarzyna Kopeć, Thomas van de Kamp, Qingqing Zhang, Wiesław Krzemiński
pmc-11496880.description: We present here the first-ever fossil flies from the family Deuterophlebiidae. The recent adults have an exceptionally brief lifespan, with males surviving only two hours. Their distinctive features include a complete reduction of mouthparts, and wing venation characterized by a dense net of false veins replacing most of true veins.

pmc-12491419.title: Development of migraine self-care scale
pmc-12491419.creator: Emine Ekici, Füsun Afşar, Fatih Ozdag
pmc-12491419.description: Self-care is known to have the ability to lessen the frequency and intensity of chronic migraines, thereby enhancing the patient’s functional ability and quality of life. No scale has been found in the literature to assess self-care in chronic migraine patients.

pmc-12847926.title: Transsulfuration metabolism is essential for ferroptosis resistance in quiescent endothelial cells
pmc-12847926.creator: Roxana Elena Oberkersch, Jacopo Lidonnici, Sebastiano Andreuzza, Eleonora Zambon, Gabriele Imperato, Silvia Pedretti, Nico Mitro, Massimo Mattia Santoro
pmc-12847926.description: Angiogenesis, the formation of new blood vessels from pre-existing ones, is a crucial process involved in both physiological and pathological contexts. During angiogenesis, quiescent endothelial cells (QECs) forming the vascular bed begin to proliferate and switch their metabolism to support anabolic and energetic needs in response to growth factors and hypoxic conditions.

pmc-13057236.title: Impact of central venous pressure trajectories on prognosis in ICU patients with sepsis
pmc-13057236.creator: Jiayi Chen, Shuhao Que, Guangyong Jin, Buqing Ma, Hongwei Zhang
pmc-13057236.description: Sepsis is a life-threatening condition characterized by organ dysfunction due to a dysregulated host response to infection. Optimal fluid resuscitation remains a challenge in sepsis management, and central venous pressure (CVP) is often used as a surrogate marker to guide therapy. However, the prognostic value of dynamic CVP changes remains unclear.

pmc-13103362.title: Prospective multicentre study of upper respiratory mucosal transcriptomics reveals two major endotypes of critically ill COVID-19 patients
pmc-13103362.creator: Pierre Bay, Laure Boizeau, Sébastien Préau, Raphaël Favory, Aurélie Guigon, Nicholas Heming, Elyanne Gault, Tài Pham, Amal Chaghouri, Matthieu Turpin, Laurence Morand-Joubert, Sébastien Jochmans, Aurélia Pitsch, Adrien Joseph, Damien Contou, Amandine Henry, Damien Roux, Quentin Le Hingrat, Antoine G
pmc-13103362.description: BackgroundSevere COVID-19 is associated with dysregulated immune responses. Immune responses heterogeneity was previously reported during the first waves of the pandemic. We aimed to characterise mucosal transcriptomic profiles in critically-ill patients during the Omicron era.MethodsThis prospective multicentre study included 94 critically-ill COVID-19 patients between May 2022 and August 2023.

pmc-13257616.title: A Coupled Inflammatory–Fibrotic–Nitrosative Axis in Patients with Patent Foramen Ovale and Cryptogenic Stroke
pmc-13257616.creator: Michał Tworek, Katarzyna Trojanowicz, Zuzanna Sachajko, Monika Kowalik-Pandyra, Klaudia Pacia, Klaudia Bielecka, Sylwia Szczepara, Miłosz Tworek, Joanna Natorska, Grzegorz Kopeć, Monika Komar
pmc-13257616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Patent foramen ovale (PFO) is associated with cryptogenic stroke, but mechanisms beyond paradoxical embolism remain unclear. Inflammation, fibrosis-related remodeling, and nitrosative stress may contribute to vascular vulnerability in these patients. The aim of this study was to evaluate inflammatory, fibrotic, and nitrosative biomarker profiles in patients with PFO and prior cryptogenic stroke and to determine whether these patients exhibit coupled inflammatory fibrotic nitrosative activation.

pmc-13280160.title: Hybrid Vi+ECNN framework for advanced ADHD diagnostic accuracy in medical imaging
pmc-13280160.creator: Shaymaa E Sorour, Lamia Hassan, Osman Elwasila, Tsunenori Mine, Mohamed Ali Nagy Elmaadaway
pmc-13280160.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder that imposes significant personal and societal burdens. Traditional diagnostic approaches, which rely on behavioral assessments, are susceptible to subjectivity and variability, underscoring the need for objective and automated diagnostic tools.

pmc-13282492.title: Brain imaging research is thriving in functional neurological disorder
pmc-13282492.creator: David L. Perez, Kasia Kozlowska, Selma Aybek
pmc-13282492.description: ucture and function are closely coupled in the human brain, and neuroimaging research in FND provides an opportunity to bridge the science of brain and mind in this prevalent and potentially disabling condition (Finkelstein et al., 2025, O’Mahony et al., 2023).

pmc-13329247.title: Optimizing intersectoral collaboration and citizen participation in community-level health promotion: a scoping review
pmc-13329247.creator: Jannemiek Sonneveld, Lilian van der Ven, Janna Bruijning, Niek de Wit, Katarina Jerković-Ćosić
pmc-13329247.description: ObjectivesWe aimed to map facilitators and barriers for both intersectoral collaboration (IC) and citizen participation (CP) in community-level health promotion.MethodsIn this scoping review, we searched PubMed, Embase, PsycInfo, CINAHL, Scopus, Global Health, Sociological Abstracts, and Social Services Abstracts, using keywords pertaining to IC, CP, health promotion, and local context to identify studies published between January 2013 and March 2025.

pmc-13379523.title: Prediction Error in Quality-Adjusted Life Years in Economic Evaluations of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors: A Comparison Based on Projected and Observed Updated Survival
pmc-13379523.creator: Jinyu Chen, Yichen Zhang, Kexin Han, Sheng Han, Luwen Shi, Xiaodong Guan
pmc-13379523.description: BackgroundSurvival data from pivotal clinical trials are critical for estimating quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). However, immature survival data require extrapolation beyond observed follow-up to project outcomes, introducing potential prediction error into QALY estimates used in economic evaluations. Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) present unique extrapolation challenges due to delayed responses and extended survival benefits.

pmc-13445176.title: Long-term cardiovascular risk with cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome in U.S adults
pmc-13445176.creator: Mohammed Essa, Devesh Malik, Yuan Lu, Huanhuan Yang, Erica S Spatz, Harlan M Krumholz, Kamil F Faridi
pmc-13445176.description: BackgroundCardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome staging helps identify cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk. Determining how predicted CVD risks vary across CKM stages in the U.S can further improve understanding of disease progression and help guide prevention strategies.MethodsWe analyzed 2011–2020 NHANES data using survey-weighted quantile regression to compare total CVD risks predicted by the PREVENT equations across CKM stages.

pmc-13608511.creator: Farjallah Alassaad, Bechara Haddad, Houssam Affan, Ilyas Ennahal, Walid Maherzi, Amro Yaghi, Anas Issa
pmc-13608511.description: HighlightsRaw marine sediments replaced up to 30% of natural sand in concrete.Sediment addition increased porosity, shrinkage, and carbonation depth.Preliminary single-slab runoff results remained below the adopted screening limits.Crushing remobilized fluorides and nickel, revealing end-of-life risks.AbstractThe valorization of raw dredged sediments in concrete requires simultaneous verification of engineering performance and environmental safety during both service life and end-of-life conditions.

pmc-13679858.title: Timely Initiation of Breastfeeding and Associated Factors in 20 Sub-Saharan African Countries: Cross-Sectional Multilevel Analysis of Recent Demographic and Health Surveys
pmc-13679858.creator: Tadele Derbew Kassie, Getnet Gedif, Mequanent Dessie Bitewa, Atsede Alle Ewunetie, Tewodros Shibabaw, Menberu Gete, Melkamu Siferih, Mikias Getahun Molla, Tirusew Wondie Wodie, Daniel Mulat Eshetu, Abebaw Abeje Muluneh, Aysheshim Asnake Abneh
pmc-13679858.description: BackgroundAn important strategy to decrease infant morbidity and mortality is timely initiation of breastfeeding (TIBF), which is defined as putting the newborn to the breast within 1 hour of delivery. Delayed initiation of breastfeeding may contribute to high neonatal and infant mortality in sub-Saharan Africa.
